component.name: Recoolor
component.summary: Recolor your whole GNOME desktop from one palette

description.p: Pick a palette such as Catppuccin, Dracula or Tokyo Night, and Recoolor recolors GTK and libadwaita apps, GNOME Shell, Qt and Flatpak apps, the wallpaper and lock screen, and apps such as the terminal, Text Editor, VS Code, Firefox and Thunderbird. Choose one palette for light style and one for dark, and everything follows GNOME's style switch.
Recoolor records everything it changes, and Reset puts it all back.
